description:
Use this when the user wants the timing of part of a clip changed: "slow down the part at 0:12", "speed up
        the boring middle", "freeze on the reaction for 2 seconds", "cut out 0:20 to 0:25". clip_id: from list_clips.
        Times are seconds of the clip as it plays (0:12 = 12). One change per call: speed 0.25-4 (0.5 = half speed)
        for start_seconds to end_seconds (end 0 = the clip's end); freeze_seconds 0.1-10 holds the frame at
        start_seconds; remove=true cuts start_seconds to end_seconds out. Captions follow the footage.
        Not for: the whole clip a little faster or slower (style_clip speed 0.75-1.5), silences and filler words
        (edit_clip) or trimming the start and end (edit_clip). Saved as an undoable version (undo_edit). Costs no
        Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame.
name: retime_clip
title: Change timing
